stem: A regulation changed after a training handout was printed, but the handout is still being used. What is the strongest response?
choices: Verify the current official requirement, update the controlled training material, communicate the change, and retain appropriate change documentation
Keep using the old handout until the next annual training
Tell employees informally but leave the document unchanged
Assume the printed version remains valid because it was correct when created
rationale: Compliance systems need current controlled information and a traceable way to implement material regulatory changes.
